notes:
Summary: evaluation focused on large-scale embeddings + reranking for internal code search and knowledge RAG. Primary ask: low-latency top-k retrieval (95th pctl <150ms for single-shard queries) with frequent full/partial re-indexing (daily incremental, weekly full). Corpus scope: ~40M files (source + docs), ~1.2B tokens, estimated embedding store ~2.2 TB (float16/quantized).

Recent timeline:
- 2026-01-20: Intro call (AE: Maya) — CTO (Ravi Patel), Head of Search (Monique Liu). High-level requirements captured.
- 2026-02-03: Architecture deep-dive (SE: Liam) — discussed hybrid retrieval + cross-encoder rerank for top-50, fallback model routing, and caching strategies. Notes: need cross-encoder GPU capacity for rerank at ~200 qps burst.
- 2026-02-18: Demo — Redwood hosted demo with small corpus (50k files). Fireflies ff_2026-02-18_01 attached. Customer: "We need near-prod numbers, not demo env."
- 2026-02-25: POC kickoff (private cluster). Provisioned 4x A100 nodes for embedding storage + ANN index testing. Jira ENGINF-4123 opened for runtime perf anomalies.
- 2026-03-05: Security sync w/ infra & legal — IdP SAML metadata outstanding; asked for SOC2 + ISO artifacts. SEC-78 created for encryption-at-rest clarifications.

Technical requirements / acceptance criteria (customer-provided):
- Throughput: sustained 80 qps, burst to 250 qps for 10m windows.
- Latency: 95th pctl end-to-end <150ms for retrieval-only; retrieval + cross-encoder rerank target <400ms (acceptable if rerank scaled with dedicated GPUs).
- Cost sensitivity: target <$0.12 per query (avg across retrieval + rerank) for steady-state; willing to pay for reserved capacity but want clear unit economics.
- Indexing cadence: incremental hourly for hot repos, daily full pass for the whole corpus; reembedding pipeline must support partial re-embeds without global rebuilds.
- Model preferences: open models for dense encoders (e.g., small-mpnet variants), cross-encoder for reranking (FP16 on GPU). Fallback: smaller cpu-friendly models for degraded mode.
- Routing & isolation: route by product/team, need tenant isolation and ability to pin model versions per team.

Operational notes:
- They will require SSO/SAML + SCIM for user provisioning (Okta).
- Data residency: EU code teams require embeddings for EU-resident repos to stay in eu-west region; DPA amendment required.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route p95 latency traces, and alerting on embedding drift/regression.

Quotes / paraphrases:
- CTO: "Our devs must find exact snippets across millions of files in <200ms — that's non-negotiable."
- Head of Search: "We re-index frequently; rebuild time is the killer. We need incremental re-embed flows."

POC plan / milestones:
- Phase 1 (now): Index 3M-file subset, validate ANN strategy and storage footprint, measure recall/precision vs current BM25+fasttext baseline. (Owner: Liam)
- Phase 2 (2 weeks): Scale to 15M files, run cross-encoder rerank on top-50 candidates, measure p95 and cost. Capture per-query unit cost. (Owner: Maya + SE)
- Phase 3 (4 weeks): End-to-end production-like run on 40M corpus on Dedicated/Private; confirm SLOs, run SAML integration test, finalize pricing/commit. (Owner: Maya, CSM: Aisha)
